# sendgrid_teammate (Resource)

Invites a teammate to the account via SendGrid's REST Teammates API.

~> SendGrid has no SCIM API; this resource uses the standard Teammates API (`/v3/teammates`), which is invite-based. Creating this resource sends an email invitation — it does not immediately create a queryable teammate. Until the invite is accepted, the teammate exists only as a pending invite (tracked here via `token`); once accepted, it becomes an account teammate (tracked via `username`). `status` reflects which phase the invite is currently in. Changing `scopes` or `is_admin` while still pending cancels the old invite and sends a new one (the invite `token` changes as a result).

~> Import is by `email` (there is no endpoint to look up an invite or teammate by email directly, so the first refresh after import searches both the pending-invite and accepted-teammate lists for a match).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_teammate" "analyst" {
  email    = "analyst@example.com"
  scopes   = ["user.profile.read", "stats.read"]
  is_admin = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The teammate's email address. Cannot be changed after creation; a new invite must be sent instead.

### Optional

- `is_admin` (Boolean) Whether the teammate has admin privileges. Defaults to `false`.
- `scopes` (Set of String) The permission scopes granted to the teammate. Must be empty if `is_admin` is `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `email`, which uniquely and stably identifies this teammate across the pending/accepted lifecycle.
- `status` (String) Either `pending` (invite sent, not yet accepted) or `accepted`.
- `token` (String) The invite token, while the invite is pending. Empty once accepted.
- `username` (String) The teammate's username, once they have accepted the invite. Empty while pending.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendgrid_teammate.analyst <email>
```
